card.name: Words just before 'response' in vaccine text
card.fires_on: Modifier or linking words that sit right before the word 'response', mostly in vaccine and immune-response sentences (e.g. 'diminished', 'elicit', 'expected', 'balanced').

modes.label: Adjective before response
modes.description: A describing word such as diminished or expected comes just before 'response' in a vaccine antibody sentence.
